headline: Highest risk is medium: Notion AI can expose workspace content to vendor backends, while dbt-core can egress to a data warehouse; prompt-injection and capability-conflict paths are limited by missing shared channels.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No direct shared channel is documented between dbt-core and Notion AI, so a default injection path is not proven. However, Notion AI reads workspace pages and dbt-core can call a data warehouse, so if users manually paste dbt output into Notion or vice versa, malicious content could influence downstream prompts. This is a low-risk, user-mediated bridge.
conditions: IF the operator copies dbt-generated text into Notion AI prompts or pages
IF Notion AI is asked to summarize content that includes attacker-controlled dbt output
mitigations: Keep dbt output and Notion prompts in separate pages
Add a manual review step before pasting generated SQL or docs into Notion
Use a fixed template that strips instructions from pasted content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI touches workspace pages and sends content to vendor backends/downstream model providers, while dbt-core has allowlisted network egress to a data warehouse and touches warehouse data. If warehouse-derived content is copied into Notion, sensitive data can flow into a third-party AI service in default use. The pair creates a realistic leakage path even without a shared filesystem.
conditions: IF warehouse data is pasted into Notion AI prompts or pages
IF Notion AI is used on pages containing secrets or regulated data
mitigations: Restrict Notion AI use on sensitive workspace pages
Redact warehouse outputs before copying them into Notion
Create a separate non-sensitive workspace for AI-assisted notes
Review Notion sharing and retention settings

C_capability_conflict.rationale: dbt-core has no filesystem write, git, or shell execution in the profile, while Notion AI is vendor-hosted with no host execution and limited Notion-controlled actions. That makes direct write-write conflict unlikely. The only plausible overlap is indirect coordination through shared workspace content, which is not a mutable OS-level resource here.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator maps both agents onto the same mutable workspace resource
IF the operator grants dbt-core additional write or git permissions outside this profile
mitigations: Keep dbt runs and Notion edits in separate workflows
Avoid granting dbt filesystem or git write access
Use read-only exports from dbt into Notion

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, so it may treat pasted dbt outputs or summaries as authoritative. dbt-core can generate analytics artifacts that users may then place into Notion for synthesis. Without a documented verification step between them, errors can cascade from dbt outputs into Notion-generated conclusions.
conditions: IF dbt-generated metrics or SQL explanations are pasted into Notion AI without verification
IF Notion AI is used to summarize dbt outputs as if they were ground truth
mitigations: Require source links next to any dbt-derived claim in Notion
Verify dbt outputs before copying them into workspace pages
Mark AI-generated summaries as untrusted drafts
Use a human review checklist for metric definitions

E_compliance.rationale: dbt-core touches warehouse data and Notion AI touches workspace pages while sending content to vendor backends and downstream model providers. If regulated warehouse data is moved into Notion, residency, retention, or subject-rights obligations can diverge between the two services. The profiles do not prove a specific jurisdiction mismatch, so medium is the highest supportable severity.
conditions: IF regulated data from the warehouse is copied into Notion pages
IF the workspace contains data subject to stricter retention or residency rules than Notion's defaults
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion AI workflows
Tag sensitive pages and disable AI use on them
Document a data-handling policy for warehouse-to-Notion transfers
Review vendor DPAs and retention settings before use
